checks: Read work_summary, report.json Q53 entries, fixedwin_all.csv and mc.json. Ratios in the CSV (3-2 N 0.977+-0.026 at 0.3", S/N half-window ratios) agree with the report values.

The fixed common window replaces the Gaussian fits, which were wrong for double-horned lines. This answers my round-1 fix, and the window/baseline sensitivity is quantified (N 0.78-0.85, S 0.14-0.24 at 1.0") and carried into the MC.

The uv/missing-flux test with same-project Xb47 cubes at 4.5" is a sensible null test. It shows the 4-3 cubes lose 12-39% of the flux. The effect on the 1.0" ratios is <=7% under a smooth-component assumption. This is stated as unverified and confidence is medium. I accept it, but did not re-image.

The pointing grid gives rms 0.02/0.016. The error budget includes 10% flux scale per project (14% on the ratio), missing flux, pointing, window and extrapolation. Probabilities are stated (N 188 pc P(SB)=0.95; N core P(SB)=0.68, P(AGN-like)=0.18, so not discriminating). The Q47 tie-in (tau~5-12, X_S/X_N unconstrained) and the 357 pc N/S contrast are present.

Claims are properly hedged: the core 4-3 is extrapolated, the R43/R32 beam trend is partly instrumental, and 1-0 values are literature, not measured. S is below the SB median at every beam, with a window-dependent range 0.14-0.29 that stays well below 1.
